description: This file is a web page that embeds CodeMirror editors configured for editing N-Triples and N-Quads syntax for RDF data. It includes references to JavaScript files related to CodeMirror, stylesheets, and contains sample RDF data entries with specific structure and MIME type information.

methods.name: CodeMirror.fromTextArea
methods.description: Initializes a CodeMirror editor instance from a textarea element for editing RDF serializations.
